# orchestration_reject_tool

> Reject the current stage gate in a workflow execution.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `orchestration` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=orchestration_reject_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Reject the current stage gate in a workflow execution.
If the template defines a rejection transition (e.g., loop back to
re-do the stage), the workflow follows that path. Otherwise the
workflow fails.

Call this when the user is not satisfied with the stage output
and provides feedback for revision.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orchestration_execution_id` | integer | yes | The workflow execution ID to reject. |
| `reason` | string | yes | The user's feedback explaining why the stage output was rejected and what should change. |
